sol: Multi-step profit/loss on mixture pricing; book-indicated answer: 20% loss

q: To make 20% extra profit selling at ₹60/kg, how much custard powder priced ₹42/kg should be mixed with 16kg of custard powder priced ₹60/kg?
sol: Required CP=60/1.2=50. Alligation cheap:dear=(60-50):(50-42)=10:8=5:4. Dear=16kg → cheap=5/4×16=20kg

q: Products A and B together cost ₹12000; combined selling price ₹14000. A sold at 20% profit, B at 15% profit. Find the difference between their cost prices.
Liquids X,Y are mixed 6:1 in Can A and 8:3 in Can B. In what ratio should liquid be drawn from both cans so the mixture has X:Y=9:2?
sol: X-fractions: CanA=6/7, CanB=8/11, target=9/11. Alligation gives ratio = 7:3

q: Milk mixed with 80 liters of water gives a mixture priced ₹40/liter. Pure milk costs ₹60/liter. Find the quantity of milk.
Whisky type 1 has 40% alcohol, type 2 has 55%. Mix to get 48% alcohol. Find the ratio.
Gold is 19× as heavy as water, copper 9× as heavy. Mix to get an alloy 15× as heavy as water. Find the ratio.
Gold is 17× as heavy as water, copper 11×. Mix to get an alloy 13× as heavy as water. Find the ratio.
Liquid P is 9/7 times as heavy as water. Water is 12/7 times as heavy as liquid Q. How much Q should be mixed with 70L of P so the mixture weighs the same as water?
sol: P-density=9/7, Q-density=7/12, target=1. Alligation ratio P:Q=35:24. 70:Q=35:24 → Q=48L

q: A hospital uses a salt-water solution costing ₹7.62/liter (5% salt). Another solution is 75% water (25% salt) costing ₹7.82/liter. Find the cost of 5 liters of an 18%-salt mixture. (verify against source)
sol: Alligation (25%,5% → 18%) gives ratio 13:7. Weighted price ≈₹7.69/L × 5L ≈ ₹38.45, closest to ₹38.75

q: Four drugs of equal quantity have nicotine:heroin ratios 2:3, 3:7, 4:6, 7:8. Find the combined ratio.
sol: Sum nicotine fractions (common denom 30): 12+9+12+14=47/30. Heroin=120/30-47/30=73/30. Ratio=47:73

q: Three 10L vessels have milk:water ratios 2:1, 3:1, and 3:2. Combine all three. Find the resulting milk:water ratio.
Three 39.6L vessels have milk:water ratios 3:1, 2:3, and 4:3. Combine all three. Find the resulting water:milk ratio.
sol: Milk fraction sum = 3/4+2/5+4/7 = 241/140. Water fraction = 179/140. Ratio water:milk = 179:241

q: Alloys X,Y have Cu:Zn = 5:4 and 8:7. Mix X:Y=3:5 to form alloy Z. Find Z's Cu:Zn ratio.
A ghee mixture is 60% pure, 40% vegetable ghee. Adding 20kg pure ghee makes vegetable ghee 20% of the total. Find the original quantity.
Two alloys have Cu:Zn = 5:3 and 7:5. Mix 48kg of alloy 1 with 72kg of alloy 2. Find the resultant Cu:Zn.
sol: Alloy1: Cu=30,Zn=18. Alloy2: Cu=42,Zn=30. Total Cu:Zn=72:48=3:2

sol: Diff of 1 part=3kg → A=9kg,B=12kg. Total cost=510, qty=21kg. Avg=510/21≈24.28

q: A milk vendor has 45L mixture (milk:water=4:1). 4L milk and 3L water are added. Find the new water:milk ratio.
sol: Original: milk=36,water=9. After: milk=40,water=12. Ratio water:milk=12:40=3:10
